classification_definitions.FULLY_DETERMINED: The frozen sources directly and uniquely specify the required inputs, statistic, completeness gate, sidedness where applicable, and undefined behavior.
classification_definitions.DETERMINED_BY_EXPLICIT_CROSS_REFERENCE: The frozen sources uniquely specify the rule through a direct reference to another frozen rule or clarification.
classification_definitions.DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY_NO_INFERENCE_REQUIRED: The frozen sources explicitly restrict the output to descriptive reporting and do not require an inferential statistic.
classification_definitions.UNDER_SPECIFIED_REQUIRED_RULE: A required output admits more than one reasonable implementation because a necessary endpoint, statistic, tie rule, or inferential definition is absent.

determinacy_items.determination: For each backend, use all 30 finite translation_norm_m snapshot values only after the complete-coverage gate; report median, q25, q75, and q95 with linear quantiles plus three station medians.
median(three Weak scene medians) minus median(three Rich scene medians), separately by backend.
Enumerate all C(6,3)=20 allocations; one-sided Weak-greater-than-Rich p=count(permuted statistic >= observed statistic)/20, without correction or randomization.
rotation_angle_rad and rotation_angle_deg use the same complete-coverage scene-first summaries and exact 20-allocation procedure as the primary endpoint; the role remains secondary.
SciPy spearmanr with average ranks on exactly six complete paired scene medians; formal rho/p are null for incomplete or constant input under the frozen statuses.
SciPy spearmanr with average ranks on exactly 18 complete paired station medians; formal rho/p are null for incomplete or constant input under the frozen statuses.
The descriptive direction cosine is defined for paired finite nonzero backend translation vectors; zero and missing/nonfinite vectors remain as null with the two frozen statuses.

determinacy_items.unresolved_reason: The contract requires scene-ordering agreement but defines neither the statistic nor tie behavior nor the exact reported output. Kendall tau, Spearman, pairwise concordance, exact rank-vector equality, and other rules remain reasonable but non-equivalent choices.
Both correspondence_turnover and accepted_source_turnover are frozen, while SCENE_LEVEL_MEDIAN_TURNOVER does not select one endpoint or require both in a defined primary/secondary relationship.
Spearman and the six-scene completeness gate are specified, but the required turnover side of the association is not uniquely selected from the two frozen turnover fields.
Centering and complete-pair requirements are frozen, but the association statistic is not identified as Spearman, Pearson, Kendall, or another statistic; the turnover endpoint is also unresolved.

The shuffle domain, seed, count, strata preservation, and sidedness are frozen, but the registered test statistic and its exact p-value comparison rule are not. The rule is enabled and therefore cannot be silently omitted.

determinacy_items.determination: For 10/10 finite station/backend vectors, norm(mean(v))/mean(norm(v)); exact zero denominator produces defined 0.0 with the frozen status, otherwise incomplete input produces null.
Median of the three station systematic fractions only when all three are defined; otherwise null with the frozen incomplete-scene status.

determinacy_items.unresolved_reason: The scene comparison unit and backend separation are frozen, but no estimand, statistic, inferential versus descriptive role, sidedness, or p-value rule is specified.

determinacy_items.determination: All planned trials remain in accounting; 10/10 station, 30/30 scene, 6/6 scene-pair, 18/18 station-pair, and 180/180 centered gates and explicit null statuses are frozen.

Finite available-case median/q25/q75/q95 with linear quantiles and N may be reported only under AVAILABLE_CASE_DESCRIPTIVE_NOT_PRIMARY_NOT_INFERENTIAL and can never replace formal summaries or enter inference.

Earliest schema-valid infrastructure-PASS scientific outcome is authoritative; finite solver-nonconverged outcomes remain finite, scientific nonfinite outcomes are retained and non-retryable, and unresolved infrastructure outcomes remain in denominators.

unresolved_root_definitions.required_resolution: Freeze the exact statistic, tie behavior, completeness rule, and output fields.
Freeze correspondence_turnover, accepted_source_turnover, or an explicit dual-endpoint hierarchy before any formal scientific value is read.
Freeze the exact centered association statistic and its constant-input behavior.
Freeze the permutation test statistic and exact p-value counting/comparison rule while preserving the already-frozen seed, count, strata, and sidedness.
Freeze whether the comparison is descriptive or inferential and define its estimand, statistic, sidedness, completeness, and p-value behavior if inferential.

prohibited_follow_on_actions_attestation.reason: The determinacy gate failed before implementation; choosing among reasonable definitions after this point would violate fail-closed preregistration.
